source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical AppleDouble HTML branch may allocate id_imap when parts are missing, then fail to construct id_url. This landing adds PR_FREEIF(id_imap) before the existing id free and OOM return, matching mime_imap_part_address's explicit caller-free contract. The normal path already releases the temporaries. Accepted code later removes that whole link branch, so retain this as a bounded ownership/error-exit example rather than a current rendering recommendation. No allocation failure or leak was reproduced.
title: Release the optional IMAP part address on MIME URL-construction failure
